basic_info.description: Welcome to 703 Crescent Ave, a delightful cottage style single family house located in the sought after Bernal Heights neighborhood. This charming remodeled home features a living room, dining nook, two bedrooms (one of which has an office/sitting area), remodeled bathroom. Off the designer kitchen, is direct access to a lovely garden with many mature plantings and a deck for easy indoor/outdoor living. Citrus blossoms, and Jasmine greet you as enter the wind protected oasis of your sunny backyard complete with seating areas, planter boxes and an outdoor shower. The attached garage adds a ton of storage, built in workbench, work out area, laundry, expansion potential and of course provides secure parking. This home is ideally situated, a terrific location its own and convenient for traveling to both the East Bay and South Bay with easy freeway access. Enjoy strolling to Alemany Farmer's Market, game days at Barebottle Brewing, St. Mary's Park, Cortland shops and amenities. Updated systems, and thoughtful design features make it an easy choice for discerning buyers, this property invites you to create lasting memories and enjoy all that San Francisco has to offer. Don't miss the chance to make this inviting home your own.
